newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BALTIKA SEEKS LISTING ON TALLINN OTC - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: BALTIKA SEEKS LISTING ON TALLINN OTC - REPORT.

text.p: Baltika, a clothing manufacturer and retailer, said it will seek a listing on the Estonian free market, Aripaev business daily said on Tuesday.

Baltika's head Meelis Milder was quoted as saying said that Baltika will not seek a listing on the main list of the stock exchange but would feel more conformable with companies in the same league such as Saku, Norma and Tallinna Kaubamaja on the free market.
Baltika shareholders will meet on Tuesday to discuss amendments to the company's articles of association which will allow the company to be floated and a possible share issue, the paper added.
Baltika's profit in 1996 was 13.4 million kroons and their forecast for 1997 is 15.8 million kroons, the paper said.
